targets.name: Bird on a brass medallion
targets.concealment: The small flat gilt bird is embedded in an engraved round medallion, with branch lines matching its feathers.

targets.name: Antelope engraved on a horn
targets.concealment: A fine pale-gold animal is part of the horn’s dense floral engraving, following its curved surface and material reflections.

targets.name: Heron engraved on a tube
targets.concealment: The thin gilt heron merges with fine plant etching on a curved brass tube tucked into a fitted compartment.

targets.name: Long oak-leaf embroidery
targets.concealment: The narrow gold leaf is one of several differently shaped botanical flourishes stitched into a similar-colored case flap.

targets.name: Leaf-headed pin
targets.concealment: The slim gold leaf head is mixed among many fine pin stems and gold embroidery on the red cushion.

targets.name: Ribbed metal handle
targets.concealment: Its narrow ridged gray cylinder is half nested in felt and similar metal fittings, aligned diagonally with the compartment edges.

targets.name: Long tapered mouthpiece
targets.concealment: The brown-gray tapered form is partly nested among like-colored instrument tubes, so its bell edge repeats neighboring circles.

targets.name: Stacked spotted corks
targets.concealment: A compact tan cork stack is partly surrounded by pipe rims and cloth of the same color, with its cutout lost among repeated dark openings.

targets.name: Ring-tipped silver tool
targets.concealment: The thin silver shaft follows several similar rods and case divisions and is partly crossed by felt at its lower end.

targets.name: Oval brass loop
targets.concealment: The thin oval loop is nested behind spotted corks and green felt, sharing the bronze tone and circular rhythm of nearby fittings.

targets.name: Gilt oak leaf on a notebook
targets.concealment: The delicate narrow branch is part of a busy flat cover pattern, following the book’s oblique perspective and leaf texture.

targets.name: Cobalt tea bowl
targets.concealment: The large blue bowl is exposed in the left-center compartment.

targets.name: Red embroidered pincushion
targets.concealment: The large red cushion is clearly visible on the right.

targets.name: Cream leather glove
targets.concealment: A broad pale glove lies clearly across the foreground.

targets.name: Green leather notebook
targets.concealment: The broad closed green book is clearly exposed at the front left.

review.notes: Fifteen actual targets inspected in source-context overlays. Enlarged source-coordinate grids corrected the engraved birds, horned-animal pose, notebook leaf, cork stack and the pierced brass loop. Eleven authored challenging placements and four exposed anchors. Phone playtesting pending.
